target_customer: Pharmaceutical partners and eventually patients with obesity (therapeutics developer; no revenue model sourced)
problem: Single-target obesity drugs such as GLP-1 agonists have limited efficacy and side effects; Olio uses ML to find multi-target drug combinations.
business_model: Drug development (pre-commercial); monetization route not found

founders.name: David Tingley
founders.background_notes: Systems neuroscientist, 15+ papers incl. 2020 Nature paper on brain oscillations and glucose metabolism (per YC).

founders.name: Tom Roseberry
prior_employers: Loyal (VP Engineering, Computational Biology, Drug Development)
founders.background_notes: 15+ years in aerospace, brain-machine interfaces, synthetic biology and drug discovery (per YC).

technical_complexity.rationale: Requires an ML platform plus wet-lab and eventually clinical validation of drug combinations; the team's own description claims screening trillions of combinations. Clinical translation is research-grade.

defensibility.rationale: Founders cite custom ML and real-world data; IP position not found in sources. Biotech IP and clinical data can be strong, but nothing sourced confirms patents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Obesity was a hot area in 2023 (the YC description calls Ozempic the fastest growing drug); no source found on incumbents acquiring or copying Olio's approach.

market_need_then: YC description (2023) frames Ozempic as the fastest-growing drug ever and targets better efficacy and fewer side effects; demand for obesity drugs was high at founding.
outcome_analysis: Olio Labs is active with a 5-person team and a reported seed of about $4.5M in March 2025, two years after founding. The founders ex-Loyal and Neuralink bring computational biology depth. No exit or clinical milestone was found, and funding totals conflict across databases, so the outcome remains open with high execution risk typical of therapeutics.
notes: Funding conflicts: CB Insights says $4.5M seed (Mar 2025) and $5M over 3 rounds; Caplight says total $8.5M. Only the $4.5M round recorded; lead and valuation not found. FinSMEs and Citybiz pages returned 403/not fetched, only seen as search results. Competitors at founding not found.
